# Engpaper

> > Free IEEE research papers, engineering projects, and academic publishing guidance across computer science, electronics, electrical, civil, medical, and management disciplines.

Engpaper is a comprehensive repository of IEEE papers and engineering research covering multiple domains with 2026 project collections, technology trend forecasts, and publication guides. The platform serves as a central hub for accessing peer-reviewed research across CSE, ECE, EEE, civil engineering, medical research, and MBA topics.

## Key Topics

- IEEE Papers
- Engineering Research
- Computer Science Engineering
- Electronics & Communication Engineering
- Electrical Engineering
- Artificial Intelligence
- Cloud Computing
- Cybersecurity
- Internet of Things
- Blockchain
- Machine Learning
- Big Data
- Academic Publishing
- Research Paper Writing
- Emerging Technologies

## Core Engineering Disciplines

- [IEEE Papers Directory](https://www.engpaper.com/ieee-papers.html): Main IEEE papers directory with 2026 research papers across engineering branches
- [Computer Science Engineering](https://www.engpaper.com/cse/index.html): CSE papers covering Cloud Computing, Big Data, Blockchain, and emerging computing technologies
- [Electronics & Communication Engineering](https://www.engpaper.com/ece/index.html): ECE papers on IoT, 5G, wireless technologies, and communication systems
- [Electrical Engineering](https://www.engpaper.com/eee/index.html): EEE papers covering Smart Grid, SCADA, renewable energy, and power systems
- [Civil Engineering](https://www.engpaper.com/a1/index.html): Civil Engineering papers on structural analysis, building design, and construction materials
- [All Engineering Branches](https://www.engpaper.com/engineering-research-papers.htm): Comprehensive directory of IEEE papers across all engineering disciplines and VLSI

## Research & Publication Guidance

- [How to Publish in IEEE](https://www.engpaper.com/how-to-publish-paper-in-ieee.htm): Guide to publishing research in IEEE journals and conferences with submission tips
- [How to Write Research Papers](https://www.engpaper.com/how-to-write-research-paper.htm): Tutorial on writing IEEE-formatted research papers with structure and submission guidelines

## Emerging Technologies & Trends

- [Top Technologies 2026](https://www.engpaper.com/top-technologies-2026.htm): 2026 technology forecast covering Agentic AI, autonomous agents, and Physical AI trends
- [Top Technologies 2025](https://www.engpaper.com/top-technologies-2025.htm): 2025 technology trends including multiagent systems, Generative AI, and cybersecurity
- [Top Technologies 2024](https://www.engpaper.com/top-technologies-2024.htm): 2024 emerging technologies: Generative AI, LLMs, quantum computing, and climate tech
- [Top Technologies 2023](https://www.engpaper.com/top-technologies-2023.htm): 2023 technology trends: IoT, AI, Cybersecurity, Quantum Computing, AR/VR

## Specialized Research Areas

- [Medical Research](https://www.engpaper.com/medical/index.html): Medical research papers on disease treatment, health technology, and COVID-19 research
- [Management & MBA](https://www.engpaper.com/management/index.html): Management and MBA research papers covering business methodologies and practices

## Publishing Journals & Platforms

- [IJTSRD Journal](https://www.engpaper.com/ijtsrd.htm): IJTSRD open-access peer-reviewed journal for rapid engineering and research publication
- [EUREKA Journal](https://www.engpaper.com/eureka.htm): EUREKA multidisciplinary peer-reviewed journal covering physics, engineering, and health sciences
- [Technology Center](https://www.engpaper.com/technology-center.htm): Technology journal hub including Eastern European Journal and ScienceRise publications

## Optional

- [IEEE Papers 2022](https://www.engpaper.com/2022-papers.html): Archive of 2022 IEEE papers across CSE, ECE, EEE engineering branches
- [IEEE Papers 2021](https://www.engpaper.com/2021-papers.htm): Archive of 2021 IEEE papers covering CSE, IoT, and Big Data research topics
